critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1762 lines; still growing. Previous iterations flagged the split; consider splitting outfit, wardrobe, subscription, files into dedicated routers before adding more features.

OutfitGrid.jsx 'changed' detection is by path identity. Re-selecting the same screenshot file re-uploads and generates a new path, so the slot is considered 'changed' even if the user picked the same image — acceptable but slightly wasteful (and burns a generation). A quick optimisation: skip setSlot when the chosen File has identical name+size+lastModified as current.
OutfitGrid.jsx: URL.createObjectURL(preview) is still not revoked on slot replace/clear (minor memory leak over long sessions).
OutfitBuilder.uploadPhoto: no size cap or dimension check client-side; relies on backend validation. Fine, but adding a quick client-side check (e.g. >10MB → reject) would avoid wasted uploads.

wardrobe_set_image: when image_path points to a different user's folder, response is 403 Accesso negato — good. Does not however validate that image_path actually corresponds to an existing file row (just checks path prefix). Low risk since _path_owner regex is strict, but a db.files existence check would be stricter.
IncludedNote hides itself when status is undefined — correct, but renders nothing while /subscription/status loads; brief flicker on cold loads is possible. Acceptable.
